prompt:
Create an original DiggerChain lore illustration in Boris Vallejo's classic heroic fantasy oil-painting style. Two images are VISUAL REFERENCES ONLY: first, Swords and Serpents for traditional painted rendering, rich amber/ultramarine/crimson color, theatrical heroic composition and softly brushed edges; second, our own DiggerChain keeper illustration for the four characters, costume colors and consistent painting medium. Do not copy the reference's scene or snake.
SCENE: The castle within the cave. Four ADULT friends in modest fantasy adventuring clothes discover a vast impossible gothic castle. Adrien: fair man, short chestnut hair, navy tunic, pickaxe. Mara: brown-skinned woman, black braids, rust-red tunic, small lantern. Niko: olive-skinned man, dark curls, short beard, forest-green tunic, round shield. Elise: fair freckled woman, copper-red shoulder-length hair, violet tunic, crossbow held low. All wear covered tunics, leather bracers and boots, some bronze armor; nonsexual heroic adventure. The four are substantial expressive foreground figures in three-quarter poses, not tiny silhouettes. Niko glances toward the great sealed doorway behind them. Adrien and Mara lead toward a descending staircase and distant emerald crystals. Monumental gothic arches, towers and bridges rise from blue-violet and wine-red shadow behind them, the architecture suggested in broad painted masses. Warm pearly lantern light on faces and bronze contrasts with the cold green light below. Awe, mystery and determination.
Traditional smoothly modeled OIL PAINTING, vintage paperback fantasy-cover finish, visibly painted surroundings, idealized figures, strong silhouette groups. No photographic texture, CGI, lens effects, game-engine cityscape, full engraved movie plate armor, modern film grading, text, signature, logos or borders. Wide landscape 2:1 composition, artwork edge to edge.
